name: helm4-plugin-preflight
description: Find Helm 4 plugin verification and interface migration hazards before they break CI or deployment.
targetUsers: Platform engineers and chart maintainers migrating repositories with third-party Helm plugins from Helm 3 to Helm 4.
jobToBeDone: Join repository plugin invocations with installed metadata before changing the CI Helm version, then identify unsafe verification bypasses and incompatible post-renderer paths in time to migrate, replace, or pin safely.
distributionPath: Checksum-verified Linux and macOS release binaries, go install, and an offline composite GitHub Action using the same CLI contract.
successMetric: Within 30 days, one unrelated external repository uses H4P001 or H4P002 to find an upgrade hazard and directly demonstrates a signed migration, replacement, or safe pin before deployment.

alternatives.name: Helm 4 plugin migration guide
alternatives.gap: Documents migration contracts but does not join repository invocations with the installed plugin inventory.

alternatives.name: Helm 4.2.2 plugin list and verify
alternatives.gap: Lists legacy and unknown states and verifies source artifacts, but cannot verify an installed directory or correlate repository call sites.

alternatives.name: Manual plugin.yaml metadata inspection
alternatives.gap: Shows schema fields one plugin at a time without mapping them to CI workflow invocation evidence.

alternatives.name: ripgrep migration-rule search
alternatives.gap: Finds literal flags and metadata fields separately but does not emit a joined, versioned, path-confined migration report.

duplicateSearch.summary: Compared the official migration guide, Helm 4.2.2 native plugin commands, manual metadata inspection, and repository grep against one controlled fixture; none joined workflow and installed evidence in one report.

differentiation: An offline read-only preflight limited to literal Helm plugin invocations and local installed metadata, with deterministic text, JSON, and SARIF diagnostics while delegating signature verification to Helm.
